voice.name: Raspy - Convincing and Weary Narrator
voice.why: Remi Duval's own voice (Raspy) for the tips he sells as the town's informant: low, weary, a man who walks past things and remembers.

inf_trucks.text: Trucks roll into the north east yard at two in the morning with the lights off. Same trucks, never in daylight.

inf_compound.text: The farm compound keeps its gate shut and its dogs loose. A lot of traffic for a farm that grows nothing.

inf_mast.text: Up by the hilltop mast somebody left a camp. Fresh boot prints, a cold fire. You can see the whole valley from there.

inf_scrap.text: Cars go into the scrapyard and the plates do not come out. Ask yourself why a scrapyard keeps a night man.

inf_dock.text: The dock warehouse has its lights on after the last boat. Crates go in light and come out heavy. I just walk past.
